head: FernShift shift calendar app for iPhone plans rotating work shifts
dek: FernShift is a 2.99 dollar iPhone and iPad calendar for people who work rotating shifts, with repeating patterns of up to eight weeks and 12-hour or 8-hour schedules. It was #87 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 19 November.
details: You can change single days and add overtime, vacation, holidays, paydays and notes, and share the calendar with family or friends. It's a one-time purchase with no account, ads, subscription or tracking, and the schedule stays on the phone. Fernique LLC released it on 23 October; it needs iOS 17 or later.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad, 2.99 dollars
means: If you work days, nights or a rotating pattern, the app shows which shifts are coming without filling in your calendar by hand.
todo: Search FernShift on the App Store and enter your shift pattern once; it repeats forward from there.
